---
title: Data Cleaning
format: typst
---


```{r}
# Loading Packages
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(readr)
```


```{r}
# Read in raw precinct-level vote data
raw_path <- "/mnt/data/c073_g24_sov_data_by_g24_svprec.csv"

raw_sd <- read_csv(raw_path)
glimpse(raw_sd)
```


```{r}
# Clean column names and basic formatting
sd_clean <- raw_sd |>
  clean_names() |>                                    
  mutate(across(where(is.character), str_squish)) |>  # remove whitespace
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~replace_na(., 0))) # fill NA values with 0
```


```{r}
# Make vote counts numeric
vote_cols <- sd_clean |>
  select(contains("vote"), contains("votes"), contains("ballot")) |>
  names()

sd_clean <- sd_clean |>
  mutate(across(all_of(vote_cols), ~as.numeric(.)))
```


```{r}
# Write cleaned dataset
write_csv(sd_clean, "san_diego_2024_general_clean.csv")
```
